in_marathi.name: Kameshwar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of desire
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kameshwar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kameshwar is a compound name derived from Kama, the Hindu god of desire, and Ishwar, meaning god or ruler. This name is believed to represent the divine aspect of desire, signifying the longing for spiritual growth and enlightenment.
